decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is a commoditised, non-core service that cloud collaboration platforms have eroded since the pandemic, so withdrawal is quite possible, but it still complements the voice portfolio.
Metro data centre interconnection is core to the firm's fibre and data centre strategy and has proven adoption in financial hubs.
Optical spectrum services monetise owned fibre for high-bandwidth customers and fit the firm's strategic direction.
The self-service number ordering portal supports real-time provisioning and is cheap to maintain, though it could be absorbed into a broader portal.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service whose regulatory basis is being phased out, making withdrawal likely soon, but it still yields residual revenue.
Direct voice network connections stay relevant for enterprises and service providers migrating to SIP and cloud voice.
